summary: Keep allocated worktrees out of the shared ticket index

delivery.outcome: Allocate linked tickets without changing the shared index on their delivery branches.
nonGoals: Rewrite existing pull request branches or change lease ownership.
Change the index format or explicit generator.

architecture.decision: Create ticket-specific files in linked worktrees and reserve shared index generation for explicit runs or flat allocation.
interfaceChanges: Linked allocation no longer writes project/TICKETS.md.
architecture.rollback: Revert the allocator and regression changes through protected publication.

validation.evidence: The previous allocator adds a row to the fixture index. The revised allocator keeps it byte-identical to the base.
Explicit index generation includes the selected ticket and excludes unrelated local and remote-only entries.
